short_name: MAG environmental hybrid assembly metadata schema
description: Flat record-level metadata fields for metagenome-assembled genomes from environmental samples generated using short-read and long-read sequencing and assessed for genome quality and functional potential.

mag_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG record within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the originating environmental sample.

project_id.descr: Identifier for the broader study or project.

environmental_matrix.descr: Sample matrix or habitat type, e.g., soil, sediment, freshwater, marine water, wastewater, host-associated.

site_name.descr: Field site or sampling location name.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters, if applicable.

temperature_c.descr: Environmental or incubation temperature in degrees Celsius.

pH.descr: Measured pH of the sampled environment.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity in practical salinity units (PSU), if applicable.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygen regime of the environment, e.g., aerobic, microaerophilic, anaerobic.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

short_read_used.descr: Indicates whether short-read sequencing data were used in the MAG workflow.

long_read_used.descr: Indicates whether long-read sequencing data were used in the MAG workflow.

short_read_platform.descr: Short-read sequencing platform, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq.

long_read_platform.descr: Long-read sequencing platform, e.g., Oxford Nanopore, PacBio HiFi.

short_read_library_strategy.descr: Short-read library preparation strategy, e.g., paired-end, mate-pair, metagenomic shotgun.

long_read_library_strategy.descr: Long-read library preparation strategy or chemistry.

short_read_insert_size_bp.descr: Expected short-read insert size in base pairs.

short_read_total_bases.descr: Total number of short-read bases generated for the sample, in base pairs.

long_read_total_bases.descr: Total number of long-read bases generated for the sample, in base pairs.

short_read_coverage_x.descr: Estimated short-read sequencing coverage for this MAG or sample, in fold coverage (X).

long_read_coverage_x.descr: Estimated long-read sequencing coverage for this MAG or sample, in fold coverage (X).

read_trimming_tool.descr: Software used for trimming/adaptor removal, if applicable.

read_trimming_parameters.descr: Key trimming parameters used, recorded as a free-text parameter string.

error_correction_tool.descr: Software used for read error correction, if applicable.

error_correction_version.descr: Version of the error correction software.

error_correction_parameters.descr: Key error correction parameters used, recorded as a free-text parameter string.

assembly_tool.descr: Primary assembly software used to generate the MAG contigs or initial assembly.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters used, recorded as a free-text parameter string.

polishing_tool.descr: Software used for assembly polishing, if applicable.

polishing_parameters.descr: Key polishing parameters used, recorded as a free-text parameter string.

binning_parameters.descr: Key binning parameters used, recorded as a free-text parameter string.

binning_strategy.descr: Binning strategy used, e.g., single-sample, co-assembly, differential coverage, hybrid.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds assigned to the MAG.

mag_length_bp.descr: Total length of the MAG assembly in base pairs.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the longest contig in base pairs.

n50_bp.descr: N50 contig length in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG assembly as a percentage.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness percentage, typically from a tool such as CheckM or BUSCO.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or related within-bin mixture metric, if available, as a percentage.

checkm_version.descr: Version of the quality assessment software, if used.

quality_category.descr: Quality tier of the MAG, e.g., high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality, according to the study's criteria.

taxonomy_domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assignment, e.g., Bacteria, Archaea.

taxonomy_method.descr: Method or database used for taxonomic assignment.

taxonomic_confidence.descr: Confidence score or bootstrap/support value for taxonomy, if available.

functional_annotation_performed.descr: Indicates whether functional annotation was performed for the MAG.

functional_annotation_version.descr: Version of the functional annotation software.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation, e.g., KEGG, eggNOG, Pfam, MetaCyc.

rrna_16s_present.descr: Indicates whether a 16S rRNA gene was detected in the MAG.

trna_count.descr: Total number of tRNA genes detected.

metabolic_pathways_detected.descr: Summary of key metabolic pathways inferred from the MAG, recorded as a free-text list or controlled vocabulary string.

biogeochemical_role.descr: Inferred ecological or biogeochemical role, e.g., nitrogen cycling, sulfur oxidation, carbon fixation.

viral_contamination_screened.descr: Indicates whether viral contamination screening was performed.

eukaryotic_contamination_screened.descr: Indicates whether eukaryotic contamination screening was performed.

host_associated.descr: Indicates whether the sample or MAG is host-associated rather than free-living.

circularized_genome.descr: Indicates whether the MAG was circularized or closed.

accession_number.descr: Public repository accession for the MAG, if deposited.

file_name.descr: Name of the sequence file or record associated with this MAG.

file_format.descr: File format of the associated sequence or annotation file, e.g., fasta, gbk, gff.

record_created_date.descr: Date the metadata record was created.

record_modified_date.descr: Date the metadata record was last modified.
